items.title: Live: Treasurer says Labor has lost 'political paint' from budget as he defends backdown
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says the federal government has lost "political paint" from May's budget while defending a backdown on key budget measures. Follow live.

items.title: Albanese government finds itself in policy quicksand on three core issues
items.description: The government's announced changes to its tax package are seeking to allay the fierce post-budget backlash from vested interests and some commentators.

items.title: Oil flows through strait but Lebanon strikes raise peace doubts
items.description: Some 12.5 million barrels of crude oil have sailed through the Strait of Hormuz overnight, US Vice President JD Vance says, but in Lebanon, Israel launched fresh air strikes, raising doubts over peace in the region.

items.title: The pros and cons of retiring overseas with your pension
items.description: With some foreign countries offering cheaper living expenses, it is no surprise that moving overseas to retire is increasingly attractive to some older Australians. But before you up stumps and book that flight, read this.

items.title: AFL matriarch stored guns for Dezi Freeman, helped wife get to Australia
items.description: Kay Reid, the mother of premiership players Ben and Sam Reid, reveals that she and her husband Bruce's deep ties to the dead fugitive and his family date back two decades.

items.title: New data shines light on state of EV public charger network
items.description: It's often claimed Australia has an EV public charger shortage, but analysis of exclusive data shows most fast charger sites are not congested.

items.title: Hanson's 'scary' parental leave views outdated, advocates say
items.description: Pauline Hanson's openness to discuss a winding back of paid parental leave is concerning and harks back to an Australia that no longer exists, advocates say.

items.title: Global telco escapes penalty for bank scam texts despite customers losing millions
items.description: A global telco that failed to stop more than 1,000 scam text messages from reaching Australians has faced no consequences, the ABC can reveal.

items.title: Live: Five goals and red card spark Swiss delight, American star in doubt for Socceroos clash
items.description: Switzerland beats 10-man Bosnia and Herzegovina 4-1 in a flurry of late drama, while US talisman Christian Pulisic doesn't train ahead of his side's clash with the Socceroos. Follow live.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns 'Moscow will burn' as Russian capital comes under attack
items.description: Scores of drones targeted Moscow overnight in what was Ukraine's largest attack on the Russian capital.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
